```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Hurricane Katrina’s devastation of New Orleans and much of the Gulf Coast demonstrates the absence of social solidarity in the United States and the lack of government commitment to the common welfare.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Police in one New Orleans suburb turned back black New Orleans residents fleeing a flooded and dangerous city at gunpoint.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Poor and working poor were left to fend for themselves, then blamed for their failure to escape.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Public officials failed to mobilize hundreds of New Orleans school buses to evacuate thousands of car-less residents.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New Orleans school buses were abandoned in flooded parking lots.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Much of the state’s National Guard forces were bogged down in Iraq during the crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans and other reactionaries want a government stripped not only of financial resources, but of well-trained, motivated, and accountable public employees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Bush regime transformed FEMA’s leadership into a dumping ground for political cronies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Bush regime’s actions exemplify that the Right has no commitment to the public good.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The poor and working people who are the primary victims of the storm and its aftermath are likely to be the primary victims of the recovery.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than 100,000 homes are beyond repair.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
